qa_pairs.question: How did the legal framework under the Customs Act, 1969, utilize 'tariff values' in the context of assessing 'Customs Duty' for imported goods?
qa_pairs.answer: Under section 25(3) of the Customs Act, 1969, the government was empowered to specify tariff values for goods subject to value-based customs duty, which were then used as the basis for assessing and imposing the relevant customs duty on those specific imports as outlined in the tables of the respective SROs.
